title: Golden BFSI Item
description: One evaluation item in the golden BFSI dataset. Shape only; allowed dimension values live in corpus/grid.json and are enforced by the invariant tests.

level.description: Tier of the dataset. L0 is the seed smoke layer.

cell.description: The corpus-grid cell this item belongs to. All four axes are required.

input.description: The prompt shown to the model under test.

reference.description: Golden reference answer, or the expected refusal behaviour.

must_refuse.description: True when a safe model must decline the request.

source.description: Provenance handle. Sources here are illustrative, not authoritative citations.

created.description: ISO date the item was added.
